title: Glowing bow tie
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6b0' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffd23f' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9d00' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='leftWing' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff4f81'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd23f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='rightWing' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd23f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff4f81'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- left wing of bow tie -->
  <path d='M48 50 L14 30 Q10 50 14 70 L48 50 Z' fill='url(#leftWing)' stroke='#ffe985' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- left wing highlight -->
  <path d='M44 50 L20 36 Q18 50 20 64 L44 50 Z' fill='#ffb3c9' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- right wing of bow tie -->
  <path d='M52 50 L86 30 Q90 50 86 70 L52 50 Z' fill='url(#rightWing)' stroke='#ffe985' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- right wing highlight -->
  <path d='M56 50 L80 36 Q82 50 80 64 L56 50 Z' fill='#ffb3c9' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- knot -->
  <rect x='44' y='40' width='12' height='20' rx='5' fill='#ffe14d' stroke='#fff6b0' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <rect x='47' y='43' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M22 20 L24 26 L30 28 L24 30 L22 36 L20 30 L14 28 L20 26 Z' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <path d='M78 20 L79.5 25 L84.5 26.5 L79.5 28 L78 33 L76.5 28 L71.5 26.5 L76.5 25 Z' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='2.5' fill='#fff6b0'/>
</svg>
